$comment: LangChain MCP adapters: `new MultiServerMCPClient({ mcpServers: { name: { url, transport, headers } } })` (or the servers at the top level, as older releases took them) connects to each server; `getTools()` lists the tools of each. A server with a `command` or the `stdio` transport runs a local process and is not reported. `operation` is the MCP method.
